battle.name: 不列顛
battle.brief: 雷達、航程與飛行員回收。德國戰鬥機護不到轟炸機能夠往返的全部距離。

kit.name: 噴火
kit.history: 橢圓翼與梅林發動機的截擊機。Mk IX 用來對付 Fw 190 的性能壓迫。它贏的是本土防空網，不是單機神話。

countries: 「不列顛之戰」指 1940 年 7 月英吉利海峽與英國本土上空進行的英德空權爭奪，是第二次世界大戰西線的樞紐一役，由 7 月 10 日德軍跨越海峽的前置攻擊打開序幕，延續到 10 月底。英方由皇家空軍戰鬥司令部統一指揮，總司令是空軍元帥休·道丁；作戰按四個戰鬥群分區推進：第十群（威爾斯與西南部）、第十一群（肯特與東南部）、第十二群（蘇格蘭）與第十三群（北英格蘭），群下設區，區下設前線機場，構成由預警雷達、濾波室繪圖、管制官下令到中隊起降的完整鏈條。協防單位包括海軍本土部隊、海軍航空兵反潛巡邏隊，以及以目視報警補位的皇家觀察團。對面是德國的帝國空軍，戈林以帝國航空部長身份總攬，戰術指揮分屬第二與第五航空隊（凱塞林）及第三航空隊（施佩勒）：戰鬥機聯隊負責攔截與護航，俯衝轟炸機聯隊攻擊前線機場，轟炸機聯隊晝夜襲擊城市與港口，並以教練機改裝的夜間戰鬥機與海灘堡壘部隊補夜間缺口。英方目標是保住本土與轟炸機基地；德方目標是為「海獅」登陸取得海峽制空權，讓登陸船團能在掩護下渡海。
countriesEn: The Battle of Britain was the contest for air supremacy over the English Channel and the British homeland fought between Britain and Germany in the summer of 1940. It opened on 10 July with the Luftwaffe's cross-Channel offensive, which was the preliminary to the invasion plan, and it ran on until the end of October. On the British side the defence was run as a single command under the Royal Air Force Fighter Command, whose commander-in-chief was Air Chief Marshal Hugh Dowding. Operations were divided among four fighter groups: No. 10 Group covering Wales and the south-west, No. 11 Group covering Kent and the south-east, No. 12 Group in Scotland and No. 13 Group in northern England, with sectors and forward aerodromes beneath them. That structure produced a complete chain, from the early-warning radar through the filter room where tracks were plotted, down to the controller's radio order and the squadron taking off. Supporting bodies included the naval home forces, the Fleet Air Arm's anti-submarine patrols, and the Royal Observer Corps, whose watchers supplied visual reports to fill the gaps radar could not. Against them stood the German Luftwaffe, commanded at the top level by Göring in his capacity as Minister of Aviation, with tactical command split between Air Fleets 2 and 5 under Kesselring and Air Fleet 3 under Sperrle. The fighter groups handled interception and escort, the dive-bomber groups went after the forward aerodromes, the bomber groups attacked cities and ports by day and by night, and trainer-derived night fighters and coastal defence units plugged the night gap. Britain's object was to hold the homeland and its bomber bases; Germany's object was to win air superiority over the Channel so that the invasion convoys could cross under cover.
people: 英方關鍵人物集中在指揮鏈與情報鏈兩端。戰鬥司令部總司令休·道丁空軍元帥把沿岸雷達、觀察團與戰鬥機指揮統一成一套制度，他的核心決定是集中而非分散：戰鬥機大隊留在少數前線機場，而不是分散到內陸。第十一群司令基思·帕克空軍中將負責最吃重的東南戰區，8 月 18 日一天內第十一群損失一百架戰機仍維持前線作戰；第十群司令愛德華·布蘭德少將、第十二群古爾斯頓少將、第十三群佩克少將分掌南北兩翼。技術與情報端，物理學家沃森-沃特推動「本土鏈」雷達網，海軍部則以海軍航空兵反潛巡邏隊維持海峽航道，皇家觀察團的志願報觀員以望遠鏡與聽音器補足雷達不能量度高度的空白。轟炸機司令部自 1940 年 2 月起由阿瑟·哈里斯空軍元帥接手，負責牽制德軍並掩護英格蘭南部。總理丘吉爾在 6 月拒絕了經納粹總統中介的和平方案，並在 8 月底堅持不疏散戰鬥機中隊。德方關鍵人物有帝國空軍總司令戈林，他在 8 月 13 日「鷹日」之後仍相信空軍可以勝出；凱塞林掌管第二、第五航空隊，施佩勒掌管第三航空隊；戰鬥機方面有加蘭德、默爾德斯與威克，默爾德斯在 7 月成為首位突破一百架擊墜紀錄的德國飛行員，俯衝轟炸機則由第三航空隊集中使用。
peopleEn: On the British side the decisive figures sat at the two ends of the command and intelligence chains. Air Chief Marshal Hugh Dowding, commander-in-chief of Fighter Command, fused the coastal radar, the Observer Corps and the fighter control into a single system, and his central decision was concentration rather than dispersal: fighter squadrons were to stay on the few forward aerodromes instead of being spread inland. Air Marshal Sir Keith Park, commanding No. 11 Group, held the hardest sector, the south-east, and on 18 August his group lost a hundred aircraft in a single day and still fought on the next morning. Air Vice-Marshal Sir Christopher Brand commanded No. 10 Group, Air Vice-Marshal Goulston No. 12 Group and Air Vice-Marshal Peck No. 13 Group, covering the northern and southern wings. On the technical and intelligence side the physicist Watson-Watt drove the Chain Home radar network, the Admiralty kept the Channel lanes open with the Fleet Air Arm's anti-submarine patrols, and the volunteer observers of the Royal Observer Corps used binoculars and sound-locating to cover what radar could not measure, namely height. Air Chief Marshal Sir Arthur Harris took over Bomber Command in February 1940, committed to tying down the Germans and shielding southern England. The Prime Minister, Churchill, rejected the peace feeler passed through the Nazi President in June and insisted at the end of August that the fighter squadrons must not be dispersed. On the German side the figure was Göring, who still believed after Eagle Day on 13 August that the Luftwaffe would win. Kesselring commanded Air Fleets 2 and 5 and Sperrle Air Fleet 3. The fighter leaders included Galland, Mölders and Wick; Mölders became the first German pilot to pass a hundred confirmed victories in July. The dive bombers were massed under Air Fleet 3 for concentrated use.
kits: 卡面兵器是 Supermarine Spitfire Mk IX，即噴火式戰鬥機第九型。設計定案於 1938 年，1940 年春才投入批量生產，於是本戰役的後段才成批上線，前三個月的基本主力仍是梅林 II 與梅林 III 動力的第一型。它的優勢來自梅林 61 與梅林 63 兩段增壓引擎，配合割短的翼尖與割後緣的機翼，在 2 萬呎以上的高度仍能保持功率與爬升率，正好補上第一型在高空對 Bf 109E 明顯落後的缺口；武裝是機首兩挺 20 公厘西班牙-瑞士式機砲加機翼八挺 .303 機槍。英方同時大量使用產量更高的霍克「颶風」，裝八挺機砲、引擎推力更大，直線速度與對地攻擊合適，爬升與纏斗卻不如噴火，兩者因此長期分工作業。防空縱深由「無畏」式雙座戰鬥機與塔式砲塔、海軍航空兵的「安森」式與「劍魚」式反潛機、「威靈頓」式夜間轟炸機組成。德方同期裝備 Bf 109E、Bf 110E、Ju 87B 俯衝轟炸機、Ju 88 與 He 111，並以「符茲堡」火控雷達與「弗萊亞」早期警戒雷達支援攔截；但德方地面雷達站數量有限，且在 8 月的襲擊中被英方夜航炸毀大半，始終沒有建立與道丁系統相當的地面管制網。
kitsEn: The aircraft on the card is the Supermarine Spitfire Mk IX. The design was settled in 1938 and mass production only began in the spring of 1940, so the type reached the front in numbers late in the battle; through the first three months the mainstay was still the Merlin II and Merlin III powered Mk I. The Mk IX drew its advantage from the Merlin 61 and Merlin 63 two-stage superchargers working with clipped wingtips and a cut-back trailing edge, holding power and climb rate above 20,000 feet and closing exactly the gap in which the earlier Mk I fell behind the Bf 109E at altitude. Its armament was two 20 mm Hispano cannon in the nose and eight .303 machine guns in the wings. Britain also used the Hawker Hurricane in far greater numbers, with eight cannon and a more powerful engine; it suited straight-line speed and attacks on ground targets but was inferior in climb and turn, so the two types were kept on separate jobs. Depth came from the turreted Defiant, the Fleet Air Arm's Anson and Swordfish anti-submarine aircraft, and the Wellington night bomber. Germany fielded the Bf 109E, Bf 110E, Ju 87B dive bombers, Ju 88 and He 111, supported by Würzburg gun-laying radar and Freya early-warning sets. The German ground radar network, however, was small, and much of it was destroyed by British night bombing during August, so it never matched the Dowding System in reach or in control.
tactics: 英方戰術核心是「道丁系統」：沿岸的本土鏈雷達先報出敵機方位，濾波室把多站方位交叉畫成航跡，觀察團的報觀與無線電測向補上高度，管制官再以無線電把中隊引到指定高度與航向攔截。8 月起，第十一群把攔截點推到海峽上空主動出擊，即所謂「反彈」式自由巡邏，用縮短防守半徑換取較長的射擊距離，而不是在自家機場上空等待敵機闖入。德方則以「Rotte」三機編隊與「Schwarm」大隊協同，交戰多為遭遇戰而非預先劃定的編隊戰；8 月 13 日「鷹日」之後改採沿海岸線低空突入的過境攻擊，專打雷達站與前線機場，8 月 5 日上午三座本土鏈雷達站即因遭低空掃射而中斷，8 月 16 日與 17 日兩波俯衝轟炸機低空掃射肯特郡機場，企圖在飛行員到齊前摧毀跑道。9 月 15 日德方一次投入兩波逾二百架的晝間攻勢，是全役最大規模，英方以多中隊在同一空域分層攔截，用數量換損失。10 月 2 日最後一次大規模晝間攻擊後，德方幾乎完全改為夜間轟炸，晝間制空權之爭就此收束。
tacticsEn: The British method was the Dowding System. The Chain Home radar first reported the bearing of the German raid, the filter room crossed the bearings from several stations into a track, the Observer Corps reports and radio direction finding supplied the missing height, and the controller then brought a squadron to the intercept by radio. From August, No. 11 Group pushed the interception point out over the Channel, trading a shorter defended radius for a longer firing range rather than waiting for the enemy to arrive overhead. Germany flew in Rotte of three and in Schwarm formations, and the fighting was mostly an encounter action rather than a set-piece battle. After Eagle Day on 13 August the Luftwaffe switched to shuttle attacks, coming in low along the coast to hit radar stations and forward aerodromes; three Chain Home stations were knocked out on the morning of 5 August, and two waves of dive bombers swept the Kentish aerodromes at low level on 16 and 17 August to wreck runways before the pilots could man them. On 15 September the Luftwaffe put over two waves of more than two hundred aircraft in daylight, the largest single effort of the battle, and the RAF answered by committing several squadrons to the same airspace in layers, accepting losses in exchange for interceptions. After the last large daylight raid on 2 October, the Luftwaffe went almost wholly over to night bombing and the daylight struggle for air supremacy was over.
data: 可查證的數字大致落在以下範圍。雷達方面，本土鏈約有 22 座 A 型站與 4 座近程站，A 型天線陣作用距離約 120 哩（近 200 公里），但只能報方位，不能量度高度。前線機場方面，英格蘭與蘇格蘭南部約有 80 個可用機場。兵力方面，1940 年 7 月 10 日皇家空軍戰鬥司令部可用作戰機 1,963 架，其中單座機 1,449 架、雙座機 514 架，可作戰飛行員約 1,429 人；德方在西北歐約有 2,800 至 3,500 架作戰機。損失方面，英方損失 1,023 架作戰機、544 名飛行員陣亡；德方損失約 1,887 架（英方官方統計數，德方紀錄略有出入），空勤人員陣亡逾兩千人、被俘約 1,900 人。單日數字：8 月 13 日英方損失 56 架（39 架噴火、15 架颶風）；8 月 18 日第十一群一天損失 100 架；8 月 29 日「黑色星期四」英方損失 56 架、其中噴火 25 架，德方損失 60 架以上；9 月 4 日空襲柏林的英機出動 56 架、損失 39 架噴火；9 月 15 日英方損失 56 架、德方損失約 60 架。9 月 16 日與 17 日襲擊登陸艇時，14 架布萊登海姆式出動、損失 6 架。10 月 2 日德方最後一次大規模晝間攻擊，轟炸機損失約為出動數的三分之一。生產方面，1940 年英國造出單座戰鬥機約 2,550 架（颶風 1,538、噴火 1,033），德國同年生產飛機逾一萬架，但能投向英格蘭方向者受航程與補給限制。海峽航線上，德方水面白艇於 8 月 19 日擊沉六艘貨船約 3.5 萬噸，9 月 12 日再擊沉七艘約 4.2 萬噸；而自 9 月 7 日至 11 月 7 日，倫敦連續 43 個夜晚遭到夜間轟炸。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked fall within the following ranges. On radar, the Chain Home comprised about 22 A-type stations and 4 short-range stations, the A-type mast arrays reaching roughly 120 miles, near 200 kilometres, but reporting bearing only and no height. On airfields, England and southern Scotland together had some 80 usable aerodromes. On strength, Fighter Command had 1,963 aircraft available on 10 July 1940, of which 1,449 were single-seat and 514 two-seat, with about 1,429 aircrew available to fly them; the Luftwaffe had between 2,800 and 3,500 combat aircraft in the north-west. On losses, the British lost 1,023 combat aircraft and 544 pilots were killed; the Germans lost about 1,887 aircraft on the British official reckoning, with German records differing somewhat, and more than two thousand aircrew killed and around 1,900 captured. Single-day figures: on 13 August the British lost 56 aircraft, 39 Spitfires and 15 Hurricanes; on 18 August No. 11 Group lost a hundred aircraft in one day; on Black Thursday, 29 August, the British lost 56 aircraft including 25 Spitfires against more than 60 German aircraft; on 4 September, of 56 aircraft sent to Berlin, 39 Spitfires were lost; on 15 September the British lost 56 aircraft against about 60 German losses. On 16 and 17 September, 6 of 14 Blenheims were lost in the raids on the invasion barges. On 2 October, in the last large daylight attack, the Luftwaffe lost about a third of the bombers it sent. On production, Britain turned out about 2,550 single-seat fighters in 1940, 1,538 Hurricanes and 1,033 Spitfires, while Germany built more than ten thousand aircraft in the same year, though only a fraction could be turned towards England because of range and supply. On the Channel lanes, German surface craft sank six merchant ships of some 35,000 tons on 19 August and seven of about 42,000 tons on 12 September, and from 7 September to 7 November London was bombed on 43 consecutive nights.
cause: 德國要打這場空戰，是因為西線的勝負取決於制空權與制海權。法國空軍在 1940 年 5 月至 6 月崩潰之後，德軍得以在幾乎沒有英國干預的情況下渡過萊茵河、推進到英吉利海峽，海獅行動的前提就是把英國南部與海峽的制空權拿到手。1940 年 7 月 10 日起，德國開始跨越海峽的前置攻擊，目標是英國南部的空軍基地、飛機廠、雷達網與港口。戈林在 8 月 13 日「鷹日」投入近三千架次仍未能壓制英軍戰鬥機，海獅的時間表因此一延再延。英方並非被動應戰：5 月成立戰鬥司令部，把防空作戰、觀察與情報合併成一套；把飛機集中在少數前線機場而不是散到內陸；皇家海軍與海軍航空兵守住海峽航道；6 月 4 日丘吉爾在議會宣示將戰鬥到底，6 月 22 日拒絕經中介送來的和平方案，8 月底更頂住解散戰鬥機中隊以疏散轟炸機的提議。導火線因此不是單一事件，而是海獅行動的期限與英國防空體系的韌性正面相撞。
causeEn: Germany had to fight for the skies because the western campaign turned on air and sea control. After the French air force collapsed in May and June 1940, the German armies crossed the Rhine and drove to the Channel with almost no British interference, and the precondition for Sea Lion was air superiority over southern Britain and the Channel. From 10 July the Luftwaffe began the cross-Channel offensive aimed at the airfields, factories, radar network and ports of southern England. Göring committed nearly three thousand sorties on Eagle Day, 13 August, and still could not suppress the British fighters, so the timetable for the invasion slipped again and again. The British, for their part, were not simply reacting. In May they created Fighter Command, merging the air defence, the observation service and the intelligence into one system; they concentrated the fighters on a few forward aerodromes instead of dispersing them inland; the Royal Navy and the Fleet Air Arm held the Channel lanes; on 4 June Churchill declared in the House of Commons that they would fight on, on 22 June the peace feeler passed through the intermediary was refused, and at the end of August the proposal to break up the fighter squadrons to spread the bombers was turned down. The flashpoint was therefore not one event but the collision between the Sea Lion deadline and the resilience of the British air defence system.
impact: 這場空戰改變了二戰的走向。德國從 9 月 29 日起無限期押後海獅，10 月 2 日之後放棄大規模晝間攻擊，英國本土的轟炸由城市轉為城市與海峽航線並行的消耗戰，帝國空軍的重心也隨之由西線轉向東歐與地中海，巴巴羅薩因此得以在 1941 年 6 月發動，德國才把主要兵力放在蘇聯身上而非英吉利海峽。技術上，英國用雷達加上管制系統取得的空權經驗，直接改寫了後來的戰術：道丁系統的模式被推廣到海外基地與遠洋護航，1941 年後的截擊作戰網也由此而生；同時它也說明制空權是體系的產物，不是幾架名機的產物。噴火 Mk IX 的梅林 61 與 63 兩段增壓引擎、割短翼尖的機翼與機砲配置，說明改型與換引擎可以在不換平台的前提下追回性能差距。人力上，一九四〇年夏的英國戰鬥航空隊在消耗中重整，飛行員與地勤的補充速度成為與德國工業產能並列的另一條戰線，而這條戰線後來延伸到華府與英聯邦的自願者。戰略上，這一役確立了一個範式：以雷達、管制、無線電與回收體系，把有限數量的戰鬥機轉成可持續的攔截能力。
impactEn: The battle changed the direction of the war. Sea Lion was postponed indefinitely from 29 September, and after 2 October the Luftwaffe gave up large-scale daylight attack, leaving the defence of Britain to become a war of attrition against cities and the Channel lanes alike; the centre of gravity of the Luftwaffe then moved east and to the Mediterranean, which made it possible to launch Operation Barbarossa in June 1941, and Germany was thus committed against the Soviet Union rather than across the Channel. Technologically, the air power won by radar joined to a control system rewrote later doctrine: the Dowding System model was extended to overseas bases and to ocean escort, and the interceptor network that followed from 1941 grew out of it. At the same time the battle demonstrated that air supremacy is a property of a system, not of a few famous aeroplanes. The Mk IX, with the Merlin 61 and 63 two-stage superchargers, clipped wings and its cannon fit, showed that re-engining and re-shaping could recover a performance gap without changing the basic airframe. In manpower terms, the fighting air force was rebuilt through the losses of that summer, and the rate at which aircrew and ground crew could be replaced became a front of its own alongside German industrial output, a line that later ran through the volunteers from Washington and the Commonwealth. Strategically the campaign set a template: radar, control, radio and a recovery system turned a limited number of fighters into sustainable interception capacity.
result: 結果是英軍保住了本土，德軍沒有取得海峽制空權。1940 年 10 月 2 日德方在英格蘭南部上空的最後一次大規模晝間攻擊損失慘重，10 月 5 日希特勒正式確認無限期押後海獅，此後帝國空軍把主力轉向夜間轟炸，制空權之爭在 10 月底實質結束。英軍的損失同樣沉重：1,023 架作戰機與 544 名飛行員的性命，是靠前線機場的快速輪換、雷達引導的攔截以及觀察團的報觀，才沒有在德方的攻勢下被拖垮；噴火 Mk IX 也在這一役後期成批上線，接過第一型在高空的不足。從更長的視角看，不列顛之戰並不是德國空軍的失敗總清算，而是德軍在英吉利海峽的戰略前提從未成立，因而整個海獅方案最終作廢，英國得以在 1941 年之後以本土為基地支援地中海與西北非，帝國空軍則在東線嘗試用另一套方法尋找制空權——而那一次嘗試的結果，正是 1941 年冬季之後的形勢。
resultEn: The outcome was that Britain kept its homeland and Germany did not win air superiority over the Channel. The Luftwaffe's last large daylight attack on southern England on 2 October was costly, on 5 October Hitler confirmed that Sea Lion was postponed indefinitely, and from then on the Luftwaffe turned its main effort to night bombing; the contest for air supremacy was effectively over by the end of October. The British losses were heavy in their own right, 1,023 combat aircraft and the lives of 544 pilots, and they were absorbed only by fast turn-round at the forward aerodromes, radar-guided interceptions and the reporting of the Observer Corps; the Spitfire Mk IX also entered service in numbers late in the campaign, taking over from the Mk I the high-altitude deficiencies of the early summer. In the longer view the Battle of Britain was not the total defeat of the Luftwaffe but the moment when the German operational precondition for crossing the Channel had never been created, so the whole Sea Lion scheme was abandoned. Britain could then use the homeland as a base for the Mediterranean and for north-west Africa in 1941, while the Luftwaffe looked for air supremacy elsewhere, in the east, where a different method was tried and where the winter of 1941 decided the matter.
